cases.label: 중첩 span 클릭을 한 번 처리하고 전파를 유지한다
cases.probe: const host=document.createElement('section');const root=document.createElement('ul');host.append(root);document.body.append(host);const actions=[];function add(id,parent=root){const row=document.createElement('li');row.dataset.id=id;row.tabIndex=0;for(const action of ['edit','delete']){const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.dataset.action=action;const span=document.createElement('span');span.textContent=action;button.append(span);row.append(button);}parent.append(row);return row;}let controller;try{controller=submission.createInventoryEvents(root,value=>actions.push(value));const row=add('p1');let bubbled=0;host.addEventListener('click',()=>bubbled++);controller.connect();const event=new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true});row.querySelector('span').dispatchEvent(event);observe({actions,prevented:event.defaultPrevented,bubbled,rows:root.children.length});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();host.remove();}

cases.label: 포커스한 행의 Delete 단축키를 처리한다
cases.probe: const host=document.createElement('section');const root=document.createElement('ul');host.append(root);document.body.append(host);const actions=[];function add(id,parent=root){const row=document.createElement('li');row.dataset.id=id;row.tabIndex=0;for(const action of ['edit','delete']){const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.dataset.action=action;const span=document.createElement('span');span.textContent=action;button.append(span);row.append(button);}parent.append(row);return row;}let controller;try{controller=submission.createInventoryEvents(root,value=>actions.push(value));const row=add('key');controller.connect();row.focus();const event=new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Delete',bubbles:true,cancelable:true});row.dispatchEvent(event);observe({focused:document.activeElement===row,actions,prevented:event.defaultPrevented});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();host.remove();}

cases.label: 입력칸·조합·반복·수정키 이벤트를 가로채지 않는다
cases.probe: const host=document.createElement('section');const root=document.createElement('ul');host.append(root);document.body.append(host);const actions=[];function add(id,parent=root){const row=document.createElement('li');row.dataset.id=id;row.tabIndex=0;for(const action of ['edit','delete']){const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.dataset.action=action;const span=document.createElement('span');span.textContent=action;button.append(span);row.append(button);}parent.append(row);return row;}let controller;try{controller=submission.createInventoryEvents(root,value=>actions.push(value));const row=add('p');const input=document.createElement('input');row.append(input);controller.connect();const events=[new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Delete',bubbles:true,cancelable:true}),new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Delete',bubbles:true,cancelable:true,isComposing:true}),new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Delete',bubbles:true,cancelable:true,repeat:true}),new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Delete',bubbles:true,cancelable:true,ctrlKey:true})];input.dispatchEvent(events[0]);for(const event of events.slice(1))row.dispatchEvent(event);observe({actions,prevented:events.map(event=>event.defaultPrevented)});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();host.remove();}

cases.label: 중첩 위젯·비활성·알 수 없는 버튼을 무시한다
cases.probe: const host=document.createElement('section');const root=document.createElement('ul');host.append(root);document.body.append(host);const actions=[];function add(id,parent=root){const row=document.createElement('li');row.dataset.id=id;row.tabIndex=0;for(const action of ['edit','delete']){const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.dataset.action=action;const span=document.createElement('span');span.textContent=action;button.append(span);row.append(button);}parent.append(row);return row;}let controller;try{controller=submission.createInventoryEvents(root,value=>actions.push(value));const row=add('outer');const nested=document.createElement('ul');row.append(nested);const inner=add('inner',nested);const disabled=row.querySelector('button');disabled.disabled=true;const unknown=document.createElement('button');unknown.type='button';unknown.dataset.action='archive';row.append(unknown);controller.connect();const targets=[inner.querySelector('button'),disabled,unknown];const prevented=targets.map(target=>{const event=new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true});target.dispatchEvent(event);return event.defaultPrevented;});observe({actions,prevented});}finally{controller?.dispose?.();host.remove();}
